movie_title: American Revolutionary War - Summary on a Map
introduction: In this video, let's retrace on maps the American Revolutionary War, since the end of the Seven Year

vocabulary.definition: the action of imposing something such as a law or regulation
vocabulary.example: The imposition of new taxes led to widespread protests among the colonists.

vocabulary.definition: to abstain from using, buying, or dealing with as a protest or means of coercion
vocabulary.example: The colonies decided to boycott British imports to show their disapproval of the imposed taxes.

vocabulary.definition: a hostile disagreement or situation between opposing parties
vocabulary.example: There were several confrontations between the colonists and the British forces during the Revolutionary War.

vocabulary.definition: an attack made in response to an attack by an opponent
vocabulary.example: The British troops launched a counterattack after facing resistance from the insurgents.

vocabulary.definition: to cause someone to lose confidence or hope
vocabulary.example: The defeat of the Patriots' army demoralized many of the soldiers.

vocabulary.definition: the restoration of friendly relations; the action of making one view or belief compatible with another
vocabulary.example: Efforts were made to achieve reconciliation between the colonies and Great Britain, but tensions remained high.
